items:
Welcome to your family`s new favorite beach destination – `Sun to Surf` — a stunning 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath coastal retreat just half a mile from the beach. This sleek, modern two-story home blends elevated design with family-friendly fun, offering a private hot tub, fenced backyard, and a fully decked-out game room.

You can book with total confidence as we are experienced super hosts with a strong track record of 5-star stays across the portfolio of properties we have the good fortune to care for. Thoughtful details, responsive communication, and exceptionally clean homes are what we’re known for.

Perfect for beach-loving families, couples, or groups seeking comfort, convenience, and laid-back luxury. If you haven`t stayed with us before, give us a chance, and we know you`ll be back!

⸻

Why You’ll Love It Here

• Two Levels of Modern Living – Completely updated with a clean, coastal-modern vibe, comfortable furnishings, and bright natural light throughout.

• Insanely Cool Game Room – The garage has been fully converted into a next-level hangout space featuring geometric LED lighting, lounge chairs, an Xbox gaming system, and a retro stage arcade game station. It’s the ultimate entertainment zone for kids, teens, and adults alike.

• Private Hot Tub – Installed and ready for use. Relax and unwind under the stars after a day at the beach.

• Fenced Backyard Oasis – Enjoy a propane grill, cozy outdoor seating, charming kids’ playhouse, and ambient string lights—all within a fully fenced yard for privacy and relaxation.

• 4 Complimentary Bikes – Cruise to the beach, grab coffee, or explore the area with ease. Being less than 0.5 miles to the beach makes biking one of the best parts of staying here.

• Fully Renovated Kitchen – Sleek appliances, modern finishes, and everything you need to cook and connect.

⸻

Designed for Comfort

• Sleeps 8 – Includes a king primary suite, second king bedroom, & queen bedroom with built-in bunk beds—perfect for kids or extra guests.

• Modern Essentials – Fast Wi-Fi, Smart TVs, washer/dryer, and a thoughtful layout ideal for families and groups.

• Coastal Sleek Style – Every space feels fresh, calming, and intentionally designed for relaxation.

⸻

Sun to Surf at a Glance

• 3 Bedrooms | 2.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 8
• Private Hot Tub (installed & ready)
Fully Converted Designer Game Room
Near 30A, Rosemary, Alys and Seacrest Beaches
• Xbox Gaming System + Retro Arcade Stage Game
• Fenced Yard with Grill, String Lights & Kids’ Playhouse
• 4 Complimentary Bikes
• Less Than ½ Mile to the Beach
• Fully Equipped, Modern Kitchen
• Beach Essentials (chairs, towels, umbrella, wagon)
• Smart TVs & Free Wi-Fi
• Washer & Dryer

⸻

Distance to Airports:

• Panama City (ECP): 21 mi | 30 min
• Destin–Ft. Walton (VPS): 49 mi | 1 hr 20 min
• Pensacola (PNS): 95 mi | 1 hr 45 min

Spring Break Curfew Notice:
Please be advised that March 1 – April 19, a 7:00 PM curfew for unaccompanied minors under the age of 18 will be in effect in coordination with the Walton County Sheriff`s Office.
This policy applies to Seaside, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and the majority of communities along 30A, all of which are enforcing these Spring Break safety regulations in unison with local law enforcement.
Guests are responsible for ensuring all members of their party comply with community guidelines and local regulations.
PLEASE NOTE: WE DO NOT RENT TO STUDENT GROUPS, AGE OF PRIMARY RENTER MUST BE 23 OR OLDER AND RESIDING IN PROPERTY DURING STAY.
1. Smoking is NOT allowed. Evidence of smoking in the unit after guest departure will be subject to an additional cleaning fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.
2. People other than those noted in the booking may not stay overnight in the property. Any other person in the property is the sole responsibility of Guest.
3. All our properties are privately owned; property management and the owners are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. Property management and the homeowners are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises and recreational gear provided with the premises or others whom they invite to use the premise.
4. Keep the property and all furnishings in good order.
5. Only use appliances for their intended uses.
6. Bed linens and bath towels are included in the home. Please do not use rental houses linens at the beach. Beach towels are provided in the home (1 for each guest as noted on the reservation).
7. Please know we do not rent to student groups or to guests under the age of 23. Guest whose name is on the reservation must be present for the duration of the stay.
8. This IS NOT a pet friendly property. Evidence of pets in the unit after guest departure will be subject to a $300 fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.


DEPARTURE CHECKLIST *:
• Empty refrigerator of all perishables. Remove all garbage from the home and take to exterior trash bins.
• Load any dirty dishes in the dishwasher and begin the wash cycle (use dishwasher detergent).
• Keep beds turned down that have been slept in.
• Place any used towels in the laundry room.
• Turn off all lights and ceiling fans; Close & lock all windows and exterior doors.
• Check out on time, no later than 10am CT firm. If you’re leaving prior to 10am CT please text 30A Sea Story at the number listed on your arrival details so the cleaning crew can enter the home. THANK YOU!
*Homes left in complete disarray will be subject to an additional cleaning fee. Listing sites will be provided with photographs.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
